channels.1: CellMask (host membranes; parasites take up the dye and are its brightest structures)

field.cells: HeLa-type adherent host cells infected with Toxoplasma gondii (as named in the source datasets' screen)
field.not_public: The screen's MTOC marker channel is not in these datasets; only Hoechst and CellMask are shown.

sources.used: Hoechst image and instance cell masks
CellMask image and instance nucleus masks

segmentation: Masks are the datasets' published instance masks for this field (not re-segmented here); spaCR Measure's own reconciliation (spacr.measure.measure_crop: cell >= 8000 px, nucleus >= 2000 px, vacuole >= 150 px, 90% overlap merge, cells without a nucleus dropped) decides which objects are drawn, so every outline is a measured object.
display: Per-channel percentile scaling over the whole field: Hoechst 1st-99.7th percentile (gamma 0.9) in blue; CellMask 1st-99.95th percentile through a cool-to-warm lookup table (slate host cytoplasm, warm peach for the brightest CellMask structures, which are the parasites). Mask panels show both channels as dimmed grey.
outlines: Outlines: sub-pixel contours (skimage.measure.find_contours) drawn with PIL at 4x supersampling and box-downsampled; about 1 CSS px at the page's display width. Cells #00CEC8, nuclei #3B82F6, vacuoles #FF00FF.

measure.note: 53 fields of plate 2 measured on CPU; plate2_J02_5_1 was refused by Measure (a nucleus label spanning two cells) and is not in the database, leaving 52.

classifier.label: infected = Measure linked >= 1 vacuole object to the cell

theme.note: Graph and table panels and every gap use the page background; microscopy stays on its dark image background in both themes.

pipeline.line: One whole 2000 x 2000 px field (plate 2, well P08, field 16) of the Toxoplasma MTOC screen; the panel shows a 1200 x 900 px window with 13 measured host cells and 54 parasite vacuoles: nuclei (Hoechst) blue, CellMask grey with the dye-loaded parasites warm.

Cell (cyan), nucleus (blue) and vacuole (magenta) outlines of the whole field; 37 cells, 44 nuclei and 130 vacuole objects passed spaCR Measure in the field, 13 cells, 15 nuclei and 54 vacuoles in this window.
Cells coloured by cell_pathogen_overlap_fraction from spaCR Measure (fraction of the cell covered by vacuoles): 0.000 to 0.161 in this window, 9 of 13 cells above 0; colour bar 0 to 0.3.

Cells coloured by a spaCR XGBoost score (spacr.ml.ml_analysis) for 'infected', learned from host features only (nucleus, cytoplasm intensity and texture with vacuole pixels excluded, cell shape) on 51 other fields of the same plate; this field was never trained on. 8 of 13 cells score above 0.5 (7 of them infected); ROC AUC 0.863 on this field, 0.656 on held-out training-plate fields.

Volcano of a different, public screen (GFP-TSG101 recruitment, pooled Toxoplasma CRISPR knockout, 4 plates): 414 genes, 4 with q < 0.05 (orange); GRA14, the screen's positive control, is the hit (coefficient 0.931, reported p = 0, so drawn as a triangle at the top of the axis). The MTOC screen's hits are not public, so this panel is not computed from the field above.

data.settings: Gene-level OLS regression of the GFP-TSG101 example screen (four plates), run by spaCR with the settings/regression.json shipped in einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit; results file /mnt/wd4tb/scratch/n687v3/ols/run/screen4/results/ols/results_gene.csv
data.axes: x: regression coefficient (effect on the classifier score), clipped to +-2 with off-scale genes as edge arrows; y: -log10 p, capped at 7; dashed line p = 0.05

overview.strip: 1600x400: image | masks | measurement table | classifier scores | hit volcano (panel widths 296, 296, 352, 296, 312; 12 px gaps)
overview.stack: 800 wide: image | masks; table; scores | volcano
overview.table_line: Five spaCR Measure columns (cell_area, cell_eccentricity, nucleus_area, cell_pathogen_overlap_fraction, cell_channel_1_mean_intensity) for cells 34, 36, 9 of this field, values as stored in measurements.db (nucleus_area summed over the cell's nuclei).

recruitment_field.line: One field, five views: Hoechst, CellMask, then the cell, nucleus and vacuole outlines on the same window (a 500 x 480 px window of plate2_P08_16_1).
recruitment_field.note: The MTOC screen is a recruitment screen, but its recruited-marker channel is not public; the strip shows the two public channels.

rejected_candidates.why: Measurements and 224 px single-cell crops only; no whole field is public (the old panels were reassembled from these crops).
